relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: The overexpression of BDNF also increased P2X7 expression in DRG neurons, which was validated in in vivo and in vitro experiments.

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: DRG microinjection of BDNF siRNA in DRG ameliorated chronic constriction injury (CCI) induced mechanical, thermal, and cold nociceptive hypersensitivities.

key_findings: DRG BDNF rises after CCI and its knockdown relieves hypersensitivity while overexpression enhances it.
BDNF transcriptionally activates P2X7 in DRG neurons.
